## ADDED Requirements

### Requirement: With expand_links true, a fixture bookmark carrying one external link...

The system SHALL ensure that with expand_links true, a fixture bookmark carrying one external link produces exactly one submitted url operation and a content_reference from the post to the article.

#### Scenario: With expand_links true, a fixture bookmark carrying one external link...

WHEN `expand-linked-articles-from-bookmarked-posts` is implemented
THEN With expand_links true, a fixture bookmark carrying one external link produces exactly one submitted url operation and a content_reference from the post to the article.

### Requirement: With expand_links false, no url operation is submitted and the reference is...

The system SHALL ensure that with expand_links false, no url operation is submitted and the reference is still recorded.

#### Scenario: With expand_links false, no url operation is submitted and the reference is...

WHEN `expand-linked-articles-from-bookmarked-posts` is implemented
THEN With expand_links false, no url operation is submitted and the reference is still recorded.

### Requirement: Media-only and self-referential x.com URLs never produce a url operation

The system SHALL ensure that media-only and self-referential x.com URLs never produce a url operation.

#### Scenario: Media-only and self-referential x.com URLs never produce a url operation

WHEN `expand-linked-articles-from-bookmarked-posts` is implemented
THEN Media-only and self-referential x.com URLs never produce a url operation.
